name: Claret-form clinical TGI for first-line breast
description: Claret 2009 clinical TGI form (exponential growth + exposure-driven kill with exponential decay of drug effect = emergent resistance) parameterized for first-line metastatic breast cancer: dy/dt = kL*y - kD*E*exp(-lambda*t)*y. Growth (kL) and resistance-decay (lambda) are now grounded in the open-access Krishnan 2021 HER2-negative breast / docetaxel TGI fit (same model structure, per-week units), with their published IIV; review_status is pending_human_review (a human must confirm the source table). The kill term kD is kept illustrative: Krishnan's kDRUG scales a KPD drug amount, not the dataset's dimensionless drug-effect E, so its potency does not transcribe to this parameterization. See docs/verification/workhorse-models.md SS6.

extraction.source_locator: Krishnan 2021 (PMID 33818899, DOI 10.1002/psp4.12629) Table 2: kGROW for liver/breast lesions = 0.00917/week, IIV CV 135%; HER2-negative breast / docetaxel; open access; human PDF sign-off pending
extraction.tier_rationale: Established model form; this rate is indication-specific.

extraction.tier_rationale: Resistance term unidentifiable from short trials.
